_comment: Causes for retirements that Jolpica records only as 'Retired'.
Since 2024 almost every DNF arrives without a cause, so the car
reliability controls on the site need this file. Keys: season, round,
driverId; cause must be one of the causes in statusCategories.json.
v2/unknownRetirements.json lists every retirement still missing a cause.

overrides.note: Hit the back of Piastri's car on lap 67, Canadian GP.
Hit by Antonelli at turn 3 on lap 1, Austrian GP.
Oil leak with seven laps to go, Dutch GP.
Crashed at turn 3 on lap 23 in damp conditions, Dutch GP.
Retired with damage after first-lap contact, Sao Paulo GP.
